_note: Video Game upgrades. Same format as v0.1 upgrades.json. Weak spots are high costs and players getting bored, so Own Game Engine and New Seasons fix them. patch skips game_bug, season skips game_bored.

trees.name: Product
trees.blurb: Make the game better so more people play it.

trees.name: Channels
trees.blurb: Get the game in front of more players.

trees.name: Defense
trees.blurb: Keep your players and your money.

upgrades.name: Better Graphics
upgrades.desc: The game looks amazing. Every player tells more friends.

upgrades.name: New Characters
upgrades.desc: Heroes that people make fan art of. Social media works better.

upgrades.name: Bug Fix Patches
upgrades.desc: Fix problems fast. Fewer people quit, and big bugs do not hurt you.

upgrades.name: Online Multiplayer
upgrades.desc: Play with friends online. Big appeal and more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: New Seasons
upgrades.desc: New levels every few months. Players never get bored and stay loyal.

upgrades.name: Epic Trailer
upgrades.desc: A cool trailer online. Works best where people are online a lot.

upgrades.name: Game Shops
upgrades.desc: Boxes on the shelf. Works best where there are many shops.

upgrades.name: Streamer Keys
upgrades.desc: Give free copies to streamers. More players and lots more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: Console Version
upgrades.desc: Play it on every console. Your brand jumps to new regions much faster.

upgrades.name: Game Expo Stage
upgrades.desc: Show the game on the biggest stage in the world. Growth goes up everywhere, but it costs a lot every day.

upgrades.name: Daily Rewards
upgrades.desc: A gift for every day you play. Fewer players switch to the copy.

upgrades.name: Own Game Engine
upgrades.desc: Your own tools make building faster. Daily costs go down a lot and each sale earns more.

upgrades.name: Trademark
upgrades.desc: Your name and heroes are protected. The rival copies you more slowly.

upgrades.name: Fan Guild
upgrades.desc: Superfans collect Hype bubbles for you and stay loyal.

upgrades.name: Lawyers
upgrades.desc: Sue the copycat. Their copy loses 20% right now and goes slower after.
